# R6.30 — First-pass outcome seal + the SELECT commit (manifest 284)

Stage 1 makes REQ-XH-121 mechanical — the sealed projections every
gate readout, the W4 checkpoint readout, committed summaries,
operator-console views and the site's internal profile use, carrying
cost fields only and rendering first-pass W2/W4 agent-slot outcome
fields `withheld{sealed_until_results}`; the development-partition
projection without verdict/reward/verifier fields; the declared
unsealed classes. The seal opens only at FP-RESULTS (R6.48).

Stage 2 commits before PROV-W1, through `task-selection/1`: the
outcome-blind exclusion record, the seeded split, the 10-task band-A
held-out draw with within-cell replacement orders, the 7-task
development list with its 3 smoke tasks — then the W1 window
declaration + quote PROV-W1 needs.

## Deviations / decisions recorded

- dataset.toml digests are `pending{w1_observe_ingest}` — real digests
  bind at W1's observe-pass ingest before FP-PREREG (R6.17's
  `pending{first_build_W1}` idiom; never invented).
- Declarations carry zero placeholders for `verbatim_sha256`,
  `runner.commit` and `quote_id` — the gate's readout stamps them.
- The eval battery embeds the census and reads declarations from
  `scripts/`; committed `docs/` records verify through
  `scripts/check-fp-select.sh` (readers-scan real-read rule).
- The sealed fixture is deliberately not an `inputs.json` entry — a
  second fp packet would be a second site path.
